intended_construct: Perceived integrity of senior leaders: belief that they are honest with employees.

v1_text: I trust senior leaders to be honest with employees.

intended_construct: Clarity of the direction leadership has set for the organization's future.
v2_text: Leadership has set a clear direction for the organization's future.
v1_text: Leadership has communicated a clear direction for where the organization is heading.
reason: v1 mixed having a direction with communicating it (overlap with v1 SA3). Now measures only the clarity of the direction set.

v1_text: Managers are held to the same standards of accountability as the people they lead.

intended_construct: Confidence in the quality of leadership decisions.
v2_text: I have confidence in the decisions made by leadership.
v1_text: I have confidence in the decisions made by leadership.
reason: Clear, single concept.

intended_construct: Leaders translating organizational priorities into what they mean for the employee's team.
v2_text: Leaders explain what the organization's priorities mean for my team.
v1_text: Strategic priorities are communicated to employees on a regular basis.
reason: Communication of priorities is a leadership behavior, so it moves from Strategic Alignment to Leadership. Reworded from frequency ('on a regular basis') to translation of priorities for the team; distinct from LE2 (direction exists) and SI1 (employee understanding).

intended_construct: Inclusion expressed as equal respect across backgrounds.

v1_text: Employees are treated as valued members of the organization regardless of their background or position.
reason: v1 named two bases (background and position). Now one concept: equal respect across backgrounds.

reason: New. Adds how the organization responds to mistakes, which is distinct from whether individuals feel safe to speak up (OC3).

intended_construct: Meaningfulness of one's own work.

v1_text: My work gives me a sense of purpose.

intended_construct: Commitment to the organization's success.
